title.en: Creating the Bureau of Youth Affairs, Foreign Students and Foreign Schools in the Ministry of Education and Culture and Other Related Purposes

text.en:
The said Bureau shall be composed of three divisions, namely, (1) Youth Affairs Division, (2) Permit,
Evaluation and Supervision Division, and (3) Research and Documentation Division;

All laws, decrees, charters, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamations, rules and
regulations or parts thereof, that are in conflict with the Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
